items.currentModel: Security audit pipeline调用Security Manager petclinic adapter中Trivy模块；原固定&&命令；普通发布另有Harbor Push & Scan扫描健康检查，不混同漏洞分类
ensure-audit-candidate -> resolveAuditTarget/transportFetch；audit-trivy ->相同target/transport及原classifyVulnerability；candidate缺失时调用原harbor-copy child
当前audit-trivy/ensure不导入scanner-runtime，无独立scanner Pod/verifyTools/Lease检查；Manager外层Admission Resources持有Lease，不把未调用的条件补成新Gate
显式candidate只允许固定Harbor PetClinic SHA256；空candidate用live Deployment image，仍须digest pinned；不要求candidate=runtime image
ensure先查Harbor；404才取本地registry index bytes并SHA核对、创建当前build alias、调用harbor-copy、查digest；403/其他状态/child非0失败
通过Harbor API扫描adapter。审计命令不调用trivy --version、不读本地binary；backend不可用表现为HTTP/scan Error/Stopped/超时
普通发布preflight收集db/java-db metadata；ensureScannerDatabases对版本/时间校验，过期才owned refresh，刷新后必须fresh。security-audit的Trivy命令无直接DB检查
audit选择root.references中arm64/amd64 child串行scan；无匹配child则scan index，无恰好两架构限制；release harbor-scan另外明确要求两条runtime children
Harbor POST artifact/scan，GET artifact?with_scan_overview=true轮询，GET additions/vulnerabilities取JSON；不是Trivy CLI漏洞扫描
audit最终.devsecops/trivy-audit.json，包括每child scan/raw/classifications/runtime context/medium governance；release target/platform/harbor.json
HTTP传输/JSON/exec/file异常抛出原Node非0；scan findings FAIL也原Node非0；scanner CLI exit codes不由audit直接消费；candidate child status必须0，source观察保留两种失败身份
取Object.values(native).flatMap(vulnerabilities??[])；不增加schema验证。{}或vulnerabilities:null可空结果PASS；损坏JSON/null/不合法内容按原执行结果失败
复用既有trivyCounts单独验证C/H/M/L计数，缺/坏/partial报告不捏造0；auditGate本身按classifications.failures判定
仅review.image精确匹配且id/package/version匹配，mustFix=true、reachability=confirmed、fixVersion非空及positive/negative/businessPath均有证据才FAIL；其他WARN
原分类器大小写归一化后C/H强制FAIL，不受GATE_TRIVY=warn改变；原始severity值未改
父audit无独立WARN退出；Medium/Low WARN可使完整父Gate PASS，C/H/确认Medium令FAIL；缺证Policy null/NOT_TESTED
API 404/空体或json错误按原request/parse失败；本地SBOM/review缺读错误保留；不能将缺失变0
HTTP response.json、kubectl JSON、SBOM/review JSON与结构访问错误按现有catch/finally失败；无证据新增schema规则
transportFetch最多3次；可重试408/429/502/503/504以及TypeError/TimeoutError/AbortError；认证错误不重试；audit request允许409再处理原结果
fresh不更新；过期db/java-db串行更新。official manifest curl配置proxy时先proxy后direct，无proxy只direct；manifest SHA/layer验证后从镜像仓库按digest下载，没有任意旧cache降级
audit每request20s，scan最多180次/5s；Error/Stopped立即FAIL；runtime maps15s异常只记录observed=false；candidate child600s；release子扫描deadline15min
audit mkdir/SBOM/review read/最终write错误；DB临时manifest目录/headers/cleanup错误保持原语义
audit finally写report；写失败仍使Node失败，即使扫描成功；release成功/错误状态写Harbor报告也保留写入异常
audit无scanner Pod/临时文件清理流程：NOT_APPLICABLE。DB updater有owned-token pid终止/检查/移除及manifest临时目录finally清理，单列覆盖
candidate exit0才audit，否则&&短路；原Manager只选Trivy执行原Groovy，不执行其他模块/实际Summary；credential绑定、module shell及archive写失败都保持FAIL

sharedScannerRuntimeStatus: NOT_APPLICABLE: production audit does not import shared scanner-runtime; no new check invented

candidateHarborCopyBoundary.model: Original child process result is an external execution observation. Full harbor-copy internals already have frozen compatibility proof in previous Build Provenance; not rerun or recounted
candidateHarborCopyBoundary.scope: No new copy/upload/Git operation; no claim of a live child execution

auditCleanup.reason: audit-trivy finally only persists report; it neither creates scanner Pod nor owns a disposable local scan directory

limits: Audit does not directly attest freshness/version of Harbor backend DB or scanner binary
Audit HTTP409 allowed for all requests by existing helper
No audit exact-two-architecture count gate; release helper has a separate exact-two-entry check
Report response identity/header/child platform uniqueness not additionally validated
Raw fix_version is not compared against review.fixVersion; existing review evidence drives confirmed Medium
Review expiration is metadata only, no new blocking rule
Bounded runtime maps read failure is recorded, not Gate failure
No real full historical Trivy parent receipt located by bounded local search; no historical108/8 claim made
